description: Deterministic codepoint ranges for invisible prompt injection / Trojan Source style smuggling. Edit this file and document changes in .agents/skills/invisible-unicode-lint/SKILL.md.

rules.title: Unicode tag characters (U+E0000–U+E007F)
rules.detail: Used to encode readable ASCII as invisible tag letters; primary smuggling vector in agent-facing text.

rules.title: Zero-width space / joiners (U+200B–U+200D)
rules.detail: Often used to hide payloads or split tokens while appearing blank on screen.

rules.title: Byte order mark / ZWNBSP (U+FEFF) not at file start
rules.detail: U+FEFF mid-file is treated as zero-width no-break space; common steganography and injection helper.

rules.title: Bidirectional embedding controls (U+202A–U+202E)
rules.detail: Trojan Source class attacks: reorder displayed text vs logical order.

rules.title: Bidirectional isolate controls (U+2066–U+2069)
rules.detail: Isolate and pop directional isolates; used with embedding controls to confuse human review.

rules.title: Deprecated bidi format characters (U+206A–U+206F)
rules.detail: Legacy bidi controls; rarely legitimate in modern source or markdown.

rules.title: Left-to-right / right-to-left marks (U+200E–U+200F)
rules.detail: Invisible directionality changes; sometimes chained with bidi overrides.
